summary: xq-infra generates a default xq-wiremock service into xq-compose.yml with no user yaml required; every user service gets WIREMOCK_BASE_URL=http://xq-wiremock:8080 unless it already sets that env var.
details: Image wiremock/wiremock:3.13.1 pinned; container port 8080; healthcheck curl -f http://localhost:8080/__admin/health. Mounts ./wiremock->/home/wiremock only when that dir exists at generate time. Skipped when the spec defines its own wiremock or xq-wiremock service; opted out via --no-wiremock. Added before the gateway so the gateway routes to and waits on it (service_healthy); `up` prints the WireMock localhost URL.

summary: Auto-injected xq-wiremock uses a fixed host port starting at 18080, scanning upward to the first free port on conflict, instead of dynamic portRange allocation.
details: Fixed 18080 was chosen over the generic portRange allocator so consumers get a predictable WireMock endpoint, and over 5000/5001 which collide with AirPlay/Synology/IPFS on macOS dev machines.

summary: Releases are manual lockstep version-bump PRs merged to main, then release.yml publishes via a matrix of hub node-publish@v2. No bot version PR; no new git tags or GitHub Releases from this flow.
details: Maintainers set the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH on all seven publishable packages; root ci:build/verify:versions fails misaligned bumps. On main, release.yml runs hub node-build@v2 and node-test@v2 then a seven-package node-publish@v2 matrix (skip if version already in GitHub Packages). Version Packages PRs, deploy.yml/publish.yml tag/release automation, and create-platform-release were removed. Historical vX.Y.Z tags/releases stay untouched.

summary: Root ci:build runs check + verify:versions; ci:test runs scripts/ci-test.mjs (includes test:release); each publishable package has ci:publish (build then pnpm publish --no-git-checks).
details: Hub reusable workflows invoke these scripts. verify:versions reads the aligned version from packages/rest-client/package.json via RELEASE_VERSION. Do not reintroduce a separate version-bot publish path.

summary: PR build.yml and test.yml use hub @v2 (default Node 24); push to main uses release.yml shaped like the hub template: build, test, publish matrix. cucumber-report is local for Pages.
details: ExperienceQuality/.github node-build.yml@v2 / node-test.yml@v2 / node-publish.yml@v2 with package-manager pnpm. Omit node-version to use hub default 24. PR workflows do not publish. Hub npm view skip replaces a separate verify-published job.
